summary: Iteration 9: Verified all 6 asks — auto-escalation stopped (crons.yml enabled:false, Dashboard has no run-escalation-button, POST /api/cron/escalate-leads still reachable), Actionless-24h backend bucket + dashboard totals, Actionless-24h UI visible only to admin/subadmin (bucket-actionless tab + kpi-actionless card link to /leads?bucket=actionless) and hidden for team_leader + telecaller, team-leader self-assign works (leader appears in assignee list labelled '(me)' and can POST /api/leads/assign with own id then reassign back), Deselect all + Unassign bulk buttons present after row select, POST /api/leads/unassign returns 200 for leader/admin and 403 for telecaller. 5/5 pytest tests pass; frontend Playwright checks all green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2131 lines — still exceeds 700-line guideline; recommend splitting into routers (auth/users/leads/calls/reports/exports).
GET /api/calls/smartflo-webhook still exposed via api_route alongside POST (flagged in earlier iterations; still unresolved).

unassign_leads() clears team_id but leaves the lead without team scoping — an unassigned lead is invisible to the team_leader who unassigned it (they must ask admin to re-scope). Consider preserving team_id on unassign so leaders can still see their team's unassigned pool.

Actionless bucket condition uses notes: {$size: 0}. If a lead has zero notes but has other activity (calls/status changes) it will still show up. Verify with product whether 'actionless' should be driven by activity log rather than notes only.
